showPathOnTabs.enabled.title: Enabled
showPathOnTabs.enabled.description: When off, tabs show Visual Studio's own captions and the tab width is set back to Visual Studio's default (215).

showPathOnTabs.collapseMiddle.title: Collapse middle folders
showPathOnTabs.collapseMiddle.description: Show only the folder that tells the tabs apart: Admin\Index.razor instead of Admin\Areas\Pages\Index.razor.

showPathOnTabs.folderAbbreviation.title: Abbreviate folders
showPathOnTabs.folderAbbreviation.description: Clip the words in folder names (EntityFrameworkCore to EntFraCor). The file name is never changed, and a folder is never shortened until it reads like another tab's.
enumItemLabels: To fit: only when the caption is too long for the tab, and only as far as needed
Always: as short as they can go

showPathOnTabs.layout.title: Layout
showPathOnTabs.layout.description: Where the path sits relative to the file name.

showPathOnTabs.tabWidening.title: Widen tabs
showPathOnTabs.tabWidening.description: Raise Visual Studio's maximum tab width so the widest caption fits. Switching to Off sets it back to Visual Studio's default (215).
enumItemLabels: To fit: as wide as the widest caption needs
To limit: as wide as the widest caption needs, up to the tab width limit

showPathOnTabs.tabWidthLimit.title: Tab width limit
showPathOnTabs.tabWidthLimit.description: The widest tabs are made when Widen tabs is set to To limit.
